---

# 1. eftakher.me (Framer, saved HTML)

**FONTS**
- Display: `Bluu Next Bold` (serif display, 5 decl)
- Body/UI: `Geist Medium` (15 decl) + `Geist Regular` (2)
- Mono: `JetBrains Mono` (2)
- All self-hosted woff2 via framerusercontent.com

**COLORS** — Framer `--token-*` vars, light + `@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark)` pairs
- Dark surfaces: `#111113`, `#1c2024`, `#27272a` (9x, dominant)
- Grays: `#71717a` (zinc-500, 6x), `#80838d`
- Light surfaces/text: `#f0f0f3`, `#edeef0`, `#ffffffb3` = white/70% (25x = body text on dark), `#fff6`
- Accent: `#e54d2e` tomato red-orange (3 tokens + more refs)
- Glow shadows: `#ffd60080`, `#ffd40063`, `#ff8c0096` (warm orange tints), `#ff35232b`
- Slate ramp `#1e293b`/`#f1f5f9`/`#64748b` (light-theme text); single-use brand hexes (#fb7d0f, #fa096a…) = client-logo colors, not system
- Boilerplate ignore: `color:#09f`×7, `#333`, `#999` = Framer shared CSS

**LAYOUT** — max-width: `1199px` (Framer desktop breakpoint), content cols `1080px` ×3, `809px`; outer `1440px`/`1280px`

**TYPE SCALE** — px finds: `90`, `57`, `48`, `44`, `32`, `28`, `24`, `20`, body `16` (6x), `14`, `13`, `11` (13x), plus fluid computed `107.25px` hero

**BORDERS+RADIUS** — `border-radius:96px` (pill, 6x), `6px` (5x), `12px`, `99/100px`, `4px`; no heavy border usage in CSS

**MOTION** — zero CSS transitions/keyframes found = all framer-motion JS. (Cannot extract spring params from saved HTML.)

**SIGNATURE** — 11px labels + `text-transform:uppercase` (4x); headings tracked `-.02em`/`-.03em`/`-.04em`; warm-orange glow shadows behind imagery; white/70 secondary text; pill chips

---

# 2. ericsin.com (Framer, saved HTML)
